verdict.rationale: x402 documents a self-serve merchant path: add one line of code so the server returns HTTP 402 and requires payment, use the hosted CDP Facilitator to verify and settle, receive funds at any address you control, and get listed automatically in the Bazaar with "no registration form or separate API call." The npm SDK and the auth-gated facilitator were verified at runtime, and independent operators (httpay's 124 endpoints, the Apiosk gateway) report running x402 seller endpoints. Missing for 10: the CDP API key signup/onboarding steps needed to use the hosted facilitator are not evidenced as self-serve in this pack.
